facts.fact: StackAdapt launched in 2014, per the company's own blog post announcing its new logo.
facts.quote: Since the launch of StackAdapt in 2014, the foundation of the brand and the platform has been innovation.

facts.fact: According to the company, its platform supports native, display, video, connected TV (CTV) and audio formats.
facts.quote: The platform has since evolved beyond a single channel to support all major formats like native, display, video, connected TV (CTV) and audio.

facts.fact: StackAdapt announced its new logo on June 15, 2021, per the blog post's published time.
